items.label: Connected with the HK/SHK team?
items.guide:
What to check:
• HK/SHK connection call made by shift start (10:30 AM): Yes/No
• If No: number of attempts and time of 11:00 AM escalation
How:
• Check the ZoTask entry and its timestamp against shift start
• If No: Call the ACEM to understand the reason.
• Not connected by 11:00 AM: Escalate to HK Manager to arrange immediate cover

items.label: How many SHK's are present?
items.guide:
What to check:
• Number of SHKs present
• Roster allocation for this property
• Shortfall or zero count
How:
• Compare the SHK count with the Staff Roster tab (ACEM Visibility Tracker v2)
• Shortfall: ask HK Manager for cover and note affected areas
• Zero: escalate to HK Manager and Ops Manager immediately
• Ask ACEM for a live, time-stamped team photo as proof; an 'all present' message is not proof
Links:
• Check "Staff Roaster" tab : ACEM Visibility Tracker v2
Staff Roaster tab --> Need to be added

items.label: How many HK's are present?
items.guide:
What to check:
• Number of HKs present
• Roster allocation for this property
• Shortfall or zero count
How:
• Compare the HK count with the Staff Roster tab (ACEM Visibility Tracker v2)
• Shortfall: ask HK Manager for cover and note affected areas
• Zero: escalate to HK Manager and Ops Manager immediately
• Ask ACEM for a live, time-stamped team photo as proof; an 'all present' message is not proof
Links:
• Check "Staff Roaster" tab : ACEM Visibility Tracker v2
Staff Roaster tab --> Need to be added

items.label: Checked that SHK/HK staff are in uniform and properly dressed. (Share timestamped photo showing all staff together)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Photo uploaded today showing each SHK/HK in uniform
• Name and reason for any non-compliant staff
How:
• Open the uploaded photo and check each person is in uniform and properly dressed
• Count people in the photo against the HK+ SHK count
• Non-compliant staff: ask ACEM for name and reason, then raise to HK Manager

items.label: Have you got the water supply (tanker/can) for the day? Yes/No (If No, then state the reason and support required)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Water supply (tanker/can) arranged for the day: Yes/No
• If No: reason and support required
• Backup plan from ACEM
How:
• Check it in ZoSpend -Water Tanker/Can Live tracker sheet
• If No: check the reason and support requested, and confirm the backup plan with ACEM
• Supply gap: escalate to CEM and City Head
• Cross-check with the water form entry (row 8)
Links:
ZoSpend - Water Tanker/Can Form Fills

items.label: Have you filled in the water form in the PM app? (If No, then state the reason and support required)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Water form filled in the PM app for the day
• Entry present in the Water Entry Live Tracker
How:
• Compare the PM app status with the Water Entry Live Tracker
• No entry: ask ACEM to fill the water entry form in the PM app
Links:
ZoSpend - Water Tanker/Can Form Fills

items.label: Checked the model room or model bed is ready to show. (Enter the Room No.)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Model room/bed checked: Yes/No
• Room number entered
• Update time (before 12:00 PM)
How:
• Check the room number against the timestamped photo showing the room number
• Confirm it is the designated model room
• Not updated by 12:15 PM: ask ACEM to update and escalate to CEM

items.label: Checked that reception is clean and dust-free.
items.guide:
What to check:
• Reception is clean and dust-free
• Desk and floor are dust-free
• Photo covers the full reception
How:
• Check today's reception photo (time-stamped) in the PM app
• Not clean: ask ACEM for a re-clean and after-photo; route to HK Manager if unresolved

items.label: Checked that the lift is clean.
items.guide:
What to check:
• Lift is clean (floor, walls, litter)
• N/A status matches the property record
• Malfunction reported and urgent ticket raised
How:
• Check today's lift photo
• Verify any N/A against the property record
• Malfunction: confirm an urgent ticket in the R&M Tickets Sheet / SCAR and escalate to Maintenance and Ops Manager
Links:
R&M Tickets Sheet: Tickets Tracker_CL_RnM & SCAR

items.label: After how many days the garbage is usually cleared by the vendor?
items.guide:
What to check:
• Days the vendor usually takes to clear garbage (0/1/2/3+)
• Escalation level that number triggers
How:
• Compare the number with the vendor pickup log
• 3+ days: confirm ACEM has asked the vendor for early pickup or a vendor change
• Escalate by the garbage escalation matrix (thresholds still to be approved)

items.label: For how many consecutive days has garbage collection been missed?
items.guide:
What to check:
• Consecutive days garbage collection was missed
• Garbage-area photo shows the area is clean
How:
• Check today's garbage-area photo
• Match the missed-day count with the vendor pickup log
• Escalate by the garbage escalation matrix used in row 13

name: Sales calls and lead updates (Part 1 of 4)

items.label: Connected with all pending Leads (SV's, magicbricks, inside sales, etc.) till now and updated comments.
items.guide:
What to check:
• Every lead due in SV's (MTD) has a timestamped comment and outcome
• Every lead due in the Magicbricks sheet (MTD) has a timestamped comment and outcome
• Every lead due in the Inside Sales WhatsApp group has a comment and outcome
• Missed or blank-comment leads listed
How:
• Open the CRM scheduled-visit list and check comments on each due SV
• Open the Magicbricks sheet and check comment status on each due lead
• Open the Inside Sales WhatsApp group and check each lead has a comment
• Check all four sources: PM app (visits, overdue, callbacks), Inside Sales WhatsApp, Magicbricks sheet, customer WhatsApp
• Missed or blank leads: send to ACEM to update before the round deadline (12:30 PM)
Links:
• CRM: https://crm.zolostays.com/scheduledVisit
• Magicbricks sheet (city-wise): CBM_central_node_workflow_final.xlsx
• Inside sales WhatsApp group (city-wise): Whatsapp City Groups

items.label: How many short-stay check-ins are expected today?
items.guide:
What to check:
• Expected short-stay check-ins today (PM app count)
• Matches Zexpress dashboard bookings
• D-1 stale check-ins cleared
• D-1 KYC compliance
• D-1 ratings collected
How:
• Reconcile the PM app count with the Zexpress dashboard
• Check D-1 status in the ACEM Visibility Tracker v2
• Mismatch: ask ACEM to confirm with the Z Express team and note the difference
Links:
ACEM Visibility Tracker v2

items.label: How many of these rooms are ready?
items.guide:
What to check:
• Number of short-stay rooms ready vs expected check-ins
• Size of the gap (large gap = escalation)
How:
• Reconcile the ready count with expected check-ins
• Large gap: ask HK Manager to prioritise short-stay rooms and escalate to CEM and ATQ team

items.label: Started the property walk with a staff member (Upload your timestamped photo with the staff member)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Walk started with a staff member: Yes/No
• Staff name recorded
• Photo with the staff member uploaded (time-stamped, today)
How:
• Check the staff name and the photo with the staff member
• Confirm the walk with ACEM if the name or photo is missing

items.label: Checked that reception is clean and dust-free. (Share timestamped photo of reception)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Today's reception photo uploaded (time-stamped)
• Reception is clean and dust-free
• Photo covers the full reception
How:
• Inspect the photo for cleanliness, clutter and damage
• Dirt: ask HK Manager for cleaning and an after-photo
• Damage: verify the ticket and owner in SCAR

items.label: Is there clutter in reception? Yes / No
items.guide:
What to check:
• Clutter in reception: Yes/No
How:
If No, then understand the reason and ensure the problem is escalated to relevant stakeholder.

items.label: Checked the lift is clean. (Share timestamped photo of lift)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Today's lift photo uploaded
• Lift is clean (floor, walls, litter)
• No clutter
• No visible damage
How:
• Inspect the photo for cleanliness, clutter and damage
• Dirt: ask HK Manager for cleaning and an after-photo
• Damage: verify the SCAR ticket and owner; escalate to Maintenance and Ops Manager

items.label: Checked the terrace is clean. (Share timestamped photo of terrace)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Today's terrace photo uploaded
• Terrace is clean
• No clutter
• No visible damage
How:
• Inspect the photo for cleanliness, clutter and damage
• Dirt: ask HK Manager for cleaning and an after-photo
• Damage: verify the SCAR ticket and owner; escalate to Maintenance and Ops Manager

items.label: Checked the kitchen is clean (Share timestamped photo of kitchen)
items.guide:
What to check:

• Kitchen is clean
• No clutter
• No visible damage
How:
• Inspect the photo for cleanliness, clutter and damage
• Dirt: ask HK Manager for cleaning and an after-photo
• Damage: verify the SCAR ticket and owner; escalate to Maintenance and Ops Manager

items.label: Checked the model room or model bed is ready to show. (Enter the Room Number and upload a timestamped photo)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Model room/bed checked: Yes/No
• Room number entered and photo uploaded
• Update time (before 12:00 PM)
How:
• Check the room number against the timestamped photo showing the room number
• Confirm it is the designated model room
• Not updated by 12:15 PM: ask ACEM to update and escalate to CEM

items.label: Checked that the bedsheet and pillow is clean and neatly laid on the model bed. (Share timestamped photo of bedsheet and pillow)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Bedsheet is clean
• No stains
• Neatly laid, no creases
• Today's photo uploaded
How:
• Zoom into the bedsheet photo and check for stains, creases and neat laying
• Unclear or not clean: ask ACEM for a new photo and HK Manager to replace the sheet

items.label: Checked that the washroom is clean. (Share timestamped photo of model room's washroom)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Washroom is clean
• No visible dirt or stains
• Fittings in working condition
• Today's photo uploaded
How:
• Review the washroom photo
• Dirt: ask HK Manager for cleaning and an after-photo
• Broken fitting: raise a Maintenance ticket in SCAR

items.label: Were any issues found? Yes / No (If Yes, then please elaborate and upload timestamped photo)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Issues found: Yes/No
• Per issue: location, impact, photo, ticket/action, owner, due date
• No: no unreported issues
How:
• Review today's area photos and the open tickets for the property in SCAR
• No: confirm no issues are unreported
• Yes: confirm each issue is assigned and has a due date; follow up and reopen if unresolved
• Route cleaning to HK Manager, repairs to Maintenance, safety to Ops Manager immediately
Links:
• SCAR Sheet (tickets): New, Open & Pending Tickets_Live - Coliving

items.label: How many residents joined this property in the last 7 days?
items.guide:
What to check:
• Unique count of residents who joined in the last 7 days
• Duplicate or missing residents
How:
• Count unique arrivals in the New residents list tab (ACEM Visibility Tracker v2)
• Compare with ACEM's count and resolve any difference with ACEM
Links:
• Check "New residents list" tab : ACEM Visibility Tracker v2
New residents tab --> Need to be added

items.label: Of these residents, how many have you met in person and filled the OES form? (Shares Names of residents)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Residents met in person (count, names, room numbers)
• OES filled for each resident
• Planned dates for pending residents
• Each new resident met within 7 days of moving in
How:
• Reconcile last-7-day arrivals with OES responses (Goal Tracking Framework - Live Month)
• Randomly call a sample resident to confirm the in-person meeting
• Day-7 misses: check the reason and revised date
• Confirm the report lists counts with names and room numbers
Links:
• OES responses sheet: Goal Tracking Framework - Live Month

name: Central support meeting and ticket updates

items.label: Reviewed open issues and tickets before the meeting.
items.guide:
What to check:
• Open tickets reviewed before the meeting
• Status, owner and due date for each ticket
• Overdue tickets highlighted
• Tickets pulled from PM app, SCAR and direct complaints
How:
• Open the R&M Tickets Sheet and SCAR Sheet and filter open tickets for this property
• Check status, owner and due date for each
• Request ACEM's overdue summary before the meeting
Links:
1. R&M Tickets Sheet: Tickets Tracker_CL_RnM & SCAR
2. SCAR Sheet (tickets): New, Open & Pending Tickets_Live - Coliving

items.label: Updated the status of tickets under my scope.
items.guide:
What to check:
• Each in-scope ticket has real progress and a next action
• No unresolved work marked closed
• Closure evidence for resolved tickets
• Resident confirms the issue is fixed
How:
• Review the update history of each ticket in SCAR
• Inspect the closure evidence
• Call the resident to confirm the issue is resolved before accepting a closure
• Reopen unsupported closures; overdue or repeat delays to Ops Manager
Links:
1. R&M Tickets Sheet: Tickets Tracker_CL_RnM & SCAR
2. SCAR Sheet (tickets): New, Open & Pending Tickets_Live - Coliving

items.label: Attended the meeting with central support.
items.guide:
What to check:
• ACEM attended the meeting
• Support team SPOC attended the meeting
How:
• Confirm attendance against the calendar invite
• If absent: note the reason and revised date, and ask ACEM for an urgent issue update

items.label: Was it the First or Second meeting of the week?
items.guide:
What to check:
• First or second meeting of the week
• Two distinct meetings held in the same week
How:
• Check the calendar for two meetings this week
• At week end: flag a missing second meeting and arrange a revised slot

items.label: Discussed pending issues and support required.
items.guide:
What to check:
• Pending issues covered in the meeting
• Support required discussed
• Overdue tickets escalated
How:
• Compare the MoM/agenda with pending tickets in the SCAR Sheet
• Confirm each overdue ticket has an owner decision; add missed topics
Links:
1. R&M Tickets Sheet: Tickets Tracker_CL_RnM & SCAR
2. SCAR Sheet (tickets): New, Open & Pending Tickets_Live - Coliving

items.label: Recorded the agreed actions from the meeting. (Share minutes of meeting)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Minutes of the meeting shared
• Each action has an owner and due date
• Ticket reference where relevant
How:
• Compare the MoM with the discussion
• Confirm owners, due dates and ticket references
• Follow up with action owners on missing or disputed items

name: Washing machine cleanliness and damage check

items.label: Checked that the washing machines are clean. (Share timestamped photo)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Each washing machine is clean (weekly)
• Each machine identified in its photo
• Any breakdown reported
How:
• Check each washing machine photo
• Request a resend for unclear photos
• Breakdown: raise as a separate maintenance issue to the MEP team and ask ACEM to notify residents

items.label: Checked that the washing machine area is clean. (Share timestamped photo)
items.guide:
What to check:
• Washing machine area is clean
• No stagnant water
• No drainage fault
How:
• Inspect the floor, clutter and stagnant water in the photo
• Water or drainage fault: ask ACEM whether the MEP team was informed; raise a maintenance ticket if not

items.label:
Was any damage found anywhere (Reception, lift, terrace, kitchen, store room, etc.) in the property? Yes / No
If yes, mention the location, damage and rectification required.
items.guide:
What to check:
• Damage found: Yes/No (reception, lift, terrace, kitchen, storeroom, etc.)
• For Yes: location, damage, ticket, owner, due date
How:
• For No: compare area photos with open damage tickets in SCAR
• For Yes: check location, ticket creation, owner, due date and after-photo
• Escalate overdue or repeat damage to Ops Manager; Maintenance for repairs
Links:
R&M Tickets Sheet: Tickets Tracker_CL_RnM & SCAR
